children: it expects to purchase for cancellation 27.59M of its Class A variable voting shares and Class B voting shares for C$800M under its now-expired substantial issuer bid, following an oversubscribed tender offer.

The shares are expected to be bought at C$29 per share. In response to the offer, 66.8M shares were validly deposited and not withdrawn pursuant to auction tenders at or below the purchase price and purchase price tenders.
Following completion of the offer, Air Canada expects to have 252.75M shares issued and outstanding.
